name: kotlin-jargon
description: A curated Kotlin/JVM learning graph for experienced Java developers.

scripts.test: npm run test:content && npm run test:state && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:preview
scripts.test:content: node --test tests/content-pipeline.test.mjs tests/human-review.test.mjs tests/type-system-content.test.mjs tests/domain-modeling-content.test.mjs tests/collections-content.test.mjs tests/functions-idioms-content.test.mjs tests/generics-content.test.mjs tests/java-interoperability-content.test.mjs tests/coroutines-content.test.mjs
scripts.test:preview: npm run build:preview && node tests/core-semantics.test.mjs && node tests/type-system.test.mjs && node tests/domain-modeling.test.mjs && node tests/collections.test.mjs && node tests/functions-idioms.test.mjs && node tests/generics.test.mjs && node tests/java-interoperability.test.mjs && node tests/coroutines.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:baseline && npm run verify:reviews && npm run verify:generation && npm run build && npm test
